snippet.title: Infinite Minesweeper
snippet.description:
Try new relaxing puzzle minesweeper game with endless board.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.grykuby.minesweeper
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/infinite-minesweeper-grykuby/id6476042029

This is a simple logic puzzle game based on the classic minesweeper game.
Enjoy peaceful and relaxing gameplay. There is no timer, there is no rush. Take your time and predict where mines are. Score points by solving 8x8 sectors.The mine density will slowly increase the further you go. Compete with others on the leaderboards!
